explanation: An attitude where one puts others above oneself by not asserting one's own rights, but regarding others as more important than oneself.
The act of doing God's will and helping others without expecting personal gain or honor.
A state where all share the same mindset, love, and purpose within the community to bring joy to the church.
The name for Jesus as God became human, took the form of a servant, and obediently went so far as to die on a cross.
The quality of following God's will completely, even when it leads to suffering or death.
The act where God lifts up the humble and gives them a higher position than they had before.
